bio: Much to our delight, the gourmet duet, formerly of the Cornichon in the Daguerre district, has teamed up again in this stylish bistro opposite the Cluny Museum garden in the heart of the Latin Quarter. The slate menu reads like an old-school cookbook: chicken liver pâté, veal kidneys, game in season, rice pudding… Warm interior and casual, upbeat vibe....
